_comment: MCP allow-list for the GitHub Copilot coding agent.
only servers listed here are permitted at runtime. Adding a server
requires a CODEOWNERS-approved PR documenting purpose, required
permissions, and at least one golden-task that exercises a tool.
Auth is handled outside this file:
- azure-mcp: Workload Identity Federation (OIDC) for autonomous runs;
- work-iq-mcp: Microsoft 365 delegated or application auth with read-only transcript scopes;
OBO when human-triggered. Federated credentials live on MCP-side

github-mcp._purpose: Read/write this repo (issues, PRs, comments, branches).

azure-mcp._purpose: Read Azure resources; run what-if; apply UC1-output Bicep against customer subscriptions.
_required_permissions: Contributor on target RG (spec-parser-agent, scoped per UC1 output)

work-iq-mcp._purpose: Read Microsoft 365 meeting context and transcript content for review-session analysis.

fabric-mcp._purpose: Read Fabric workspace items (lakehouses, semantic models); query synthetic Gold Delta tables; trigger data-quality notebooks. Dispatched by the Sprint 13 agent-host on behalf of the Sprint 11 application-hosted agents.
_required_permissions: Fabric workspace Viewer (query Gold Delta tables, read semantic models)
Fabric item Contributor scoped to the data-quality notebook (data-quality-agent only)

entra-mcp._purpose: Read Microsoft Entra audit-log new-sign-in events for the onboarding-agent (stretch). Read-only — the only write is the welcome PR into the repo.

cosmos-mcp._purpose: Read/write the CSA Cosmos DB for NoSQL (scenarios, agent-memory, response-levers, simulation-runs). Vector + hybrid search over the scenario catalogue and response-lever library; per-run agent memory. Dispatched by the Sprint 13 agent-host on behalf of the csa-agent (Sprint 16).
cosmos-mcp._confirmation_rule: Cosmos provisioning + deletion are handled by Bicep (infra/modules/cosmos) and require `approved-to-apply` per AGENTS.md §4. Data-plane deletes are blocked during the MVP.
_required_permissions: Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor scoped to the cosmos-csa-ihzhhpf-sit account (read/write items; no delete of the account or containers)
cosmos-mcp._enabled_in_sprint: S16 (CSA what-if scenario catalogue + agent memory)
